glossary.ja: ディストーションフィールド
glossary.role: Nadesico's gravity-wave barrier; also the Aestivalis/Nadesico-unit defensive weapon in the tutorial.
Buster Ark's remote weapon pods that surround the target (Weapon 2).

glossary.series: New Mobile Report Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
glossary.role: Gundam Deathscythe Hell's jamming device (Weapon 5): evades enemy lock-on for a time, drains vernier.
Domon's second Mobile Fighter (GF13-017NJII), Neo Japan; God Finger and Hyper Mode (Meikyo Shisui)

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness

glossary.role: Network of (hundreds of) orbital military satellite cannons of the Rainen Project; Gun Ark/Buster Ark can call it via the Guardian System.
Neue Ziel's wired claw arms, fired from the main arms (有線クローアーム = Wired Claw Arm).
Unit ability; game also writes アビリティー.
Sazabi's remote psycommu weapon (Weapon 6); ν Gundam's version is フィン・ファンネル (Fin Funnel).
Nanajin's ability (auto-activates at low armor; also usable as a barrier) and the series title (menu3022#12).
Brain energy in weapon names: チャクラシールド (Chakra Shield), チャクラ光 (Chakra Light), チャクラ光一斉射撃, チャクラフラッシュ.
Boost thrust resource (バーニア消費).
Life energy of Byston Well that powers aura machines; used alone in lines like オーラの力 / 悪しきオーラ / オーラ光.
